title: Data Import Guide
text: molpathR provides dedicated parsers molecular pathology data source. parsers return molpath_parsed objects can combined unified database using mp_build_db().

title: Data Import Guide
code: library(molpathR)  # Parse a single VCF file parsed_vcf <- mp_read_vcf("path/to/variants.vcf") parsed_vcf  # View the data head(parsed_vcf$data)

what: Building a database from multiple sources
title: Data Import Guide
code: # Parse several files vcf1 <- mp_read_vcf("sample1.vcf") vcf2 <- mp_read_vcf("sample2.vcf") surv <- mp_read_survival("survival_data.xlsx")  # Build the database db <- mp_build_db(vcf1, vcf2, surv)  # Validate integrity mp_validate_db(db)  # Save for later use mp_save_db(db, "my_database.rds")

title: Data Import Guide
code: # Automatically detects file type and uses the correct parser parsed <- mp_read_auto("unknown_file.vcf") parsed$source_type

code: # Malformed files produce warnings, not crashes result <- mp_read_vcf("possibly_broken.vcf")

what: Create a synthetic molecular pathology database — mp_example_db
title: Create a synthetic molecular pathology database — mp_example_db
text: Generates realistic entirely synthetic molpath_db object containing patients, samples, variants, reports, clinical data, survival data. data set designed mirror structure real-world molecular pathology database plausible clinical correlations, including diagnosis-specific mutation profiles, TNM staging, survival outcomes.

title: Create a synthetic molecular pathology database — mp_example_db
code: mp_example_db(n_patients = 150, seed = 42)

title: Create a synthetic molecular pathology database — mp_example_db
text: n_patients Integer. Number patients generate. Default 150. seed Integer. Random seed reproducibility. Default 42.

title: Create a synthetic molecular pathology database — mp_example_db
text: molpath_db object (S3 list) containing: patients tibble columns patient_id, age, sex, diagnosis, diagnosis_date. samples tibble columns sample_id, patient_id, sample_type, date, source_file. variants tibble columns sample_id, gene, variant, variant_type, classification, vaf, chromosome, position, ref_allele, alt_allele. reports tibble columns sample_id, report_type, report_date, summary_text, source_file. clinical tibble columns patient_id, parameter, value, date, source. survival tibble columns patient_id, os_months, os_status, pfs_months, pfs_status.

title: molpathR 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Parsers VCF, FASTQ, BAM, XML reports, PDF reports, Nexus pathology/clinical exports, survival data. -memory relational database (molpath_db) build, merge, validate, save/load operations. Query engine tidy evaluation, variant filtering, free-text search. Six visualization functions: variant landscape, mutation spectrum, survival curves, cohort overview, VAF distribution, patient timeline. Interactive Shiny application 6 tabs cross-tab interactivity. Synthetic data generator (mp_example_db()) demonstration testing.
